findings_qualitative.value: HDO profile asymmetric at low velocity with brighter redshifted emission

evidence.quote: the redshifted emission is clearly brighter than the blueshifted.

claims.experiment: Detection and LTE/LVG analysis of high-excitation CH3CHO and HDO lines
claims.result: T_kin > 70 K, densities >= 1e7 cm^-3, compact emission
claims.finding: First hot corino detected in Orion

evidence.quote: We thus report the detection of the first hot corino in Orion.

claims.hypothesis: CH3CHO abundance in HH212 resembles other hot corinos
claims.finding: Similar to hot corinos in Ophiuchus (IRAS16293-2422)

evidence.quote: The acetaldehyde abundance is similar to that measured in hot corinos located in low-mass star forming regions in Ophiuchus.

claims.experiment: Profile comparison with CH3CHO and optically thin/thick LVG analysis
claims.result: Red brighter than blue at <= 2 km/s; both limits require outflow
claims.finding: At least some deuterated water is in slow outflowing gas

evidence.quote: The asymmetric HDO profile at low velocities indicates that at least some of the deuterated water is associated with slow outflowing gas

claims.hypothesis: Optically thick HDO arises in a compact dense disk wind
claims.experiment: tau = 1 LVG curves vs observed intensity
claims.result: size 18–37 AU, n >= 1e9 cm^-3, T ~100 K
claims.finding: Tempting to associate with disk wind (speculative)

evidence.quote: it is tempting to speculate that the observed gas may be associated with a disk wind gas accelerated at the base.

why_this_data.value: HH212 has both a bright bipolar jet and a compact rotating disk, ideal for linking hot corino, disk and outflow

evidence.quote: HH212 stands out as being the perfect target for investigating the link between hot corino, disk, and outflow in the protostellar stage.

why_this_method.value: Two limiting opacity cases studied to separate kinematic and radiative effects on HDO profile

evidence.quote: we study two limit situations: (i) the optically thin case where the kinematics will dominate and (ii) the optically thick case

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Rotating disk origin of HDO low-velocity emission rejected due to large red/blue asymmetry

evidence.quote: However, the low-velocity range of the HDO line being due to the protostellar disk is not supported by the large (factor of 2) difference
We can also rule out an origin from the rotating infalling envelope

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Fast SiO jet origin rejected (SiO too broad)

evidence.quote: is definitely too broad (up to $\pm$ 20 km s$^{-1}$) for HDO to probe the inner portion of the fast jet traced by SiO
